headline: Executive order closed federal executive departments and agencies for one day, December 5, 2018.
what_it_does: This order closed executive departments and agencies of the federal government on December 5, 2018. That date was set aside as a national day of mourning for former President George H.W. Bush, who died on November 30, 2018. Only the title was provided, so details such as which workers had to stay on duty are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal government employees in executive departments and agencies
who_it_affects.how: Their offices were closed on December 5, 2018, so most did not report to work that day.

who_it_affects.group: People who needed in-person services from federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: Federal offices that closed were not open to the public on December 5, 2018.
